title: Safety wait
summary: Shown on the new phone during the delay of a slow recovery (e-mail now; guardians and CPF later). It shows when the account or the new PIN takes effect, polls the server, and collects the credentials when the delay ends.

purpose.description: access: the account comes to this phone. pinReset: the new PIN takes effect.

method.description: The factor that started the delay. Sets which delay applies (recoveryDelayHours).

readyAt.description: ready_at from the server. Shown with the system date formatter.

phase.description: claiming: the delay ended and POST /v1/recovery/{recoveryId}/claim runs. ready: done. cancelled: an old device cancelled. expired: the claim window passed.

appear.effect: Reads the kept recovery (recovery_id, claim_secret, purpose, ready_at) and polls POST /v1/recovery/{recoveryId}/claim on open, on foreground and at readyAt.

claim.effect: After readyAt: access with state completed returns user_id, password and recovery_token once; the app stores them (password this device only, token synced), signs in with Client.login, deletes the kept recovery, shows bipe_recovery_ready and opens chat-list, then encryption-status. pinReset with state completed shows bipe_recovery_pin_ready.

startOver.effect: From cancelled or expired: deletes the kept recovery and opens recovery-start.

notes: The kept recovery lives on this device only (iOS Keychain ThisDeviceOnly, Android storage without backup) until the claim ends. The app can close during the wait; account-start opens this screen while a kept recovery exists.
Delays: recoveryDelayHours in registries/accounts.json (email 24, guardian 24, cpf 72). After readyAt the phone has recoveryClaimDays to claim, then expired.

bipe_recovery_waiting_body and bipe_recovery_waiting_pin_body take readyAt formatted by the system. bipe_recovery_history_note shows under ready for access: the account came back without the message history.
guardian and cpf are not built on the server yet. The screen handles them so a server change needs no new app screen.

Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.claimRecovery, BipeCredentialStore.pendingRecovery and deletePendingRecovery, BipeRecoveryStarted (iOS); BipeDeviceAccount.claim, pendingClaim and forgetPendingClaim (Android).
